entries.3b95f7517a5f8a7d: This service provides comprehensive CFO-area consulting through on-site practical execution support, including support for building budget-versus-actual management and KPI management systems, accelerating the closing of accounts, building cost accounting systems, formulating business plans, building personnel systems and implementing systems. Demand is also expanding for the building of management systems (PMI) at portfolio companies of private equity funds.
entries.4b2c1c7909e1d0f1: This service fully supports companies expanding into Southeast Asia, including decision-making support and carrying out the procedures required locally. It is provided through local subsidiaries in Vietnam, the Philippines and others.
entries.6bb08eedeac369b8: This business provides one-stop CFO functions to companies in a transformation phase, from visualizing management issues through to formulating and executing solutions. Its features are on-site practical execution support and the building of structures that enable client companies to operate independently. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,402 million.
entries.7bd569d26cd7379f: This service supports companies in a turnaround phase that face issues such as excessive debt by conducting financial and business due diligence, supporting the formulation of turnaround plans and monitoring their execution, so that the business can return to a stable footing. For companies that have entered a re-growth stage, it also provides execution support to enhance corporate value.
entries.7cad79f9c4eeb656: Companies that wish to outsource routine tasks of their corporate departments
entries.900da00e51476c45: Growth companies in which investments are made

entries.c22eba38db03a055: This business invests in companies with growth potential and seeks to enhance the corporate value of investee companies by dispatching management personnel and providing management support. It is not included in reportable segments, and segment information is omitted because its quantitative materiality is limited. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥15 million.
entries.ced669f05881dee6: This service entrusts and carries out routine, highly repetitive tasks in corporate departments, such as payroll processing. Its aim is to build a structure that enables client companies to concentrate their management resources on strategic work.
